# 98thPercentile

> > 98thPercentile is an online learning platform offering advanced academic programs in Math, English, Coding, and Public Speaking for students in grades 1-12, including specialized programs like ElevatEd for leadership development and preparation for Honors, AP, IB, and Gifted programs.

The platform provides comprehensive educational resources through live classes, interactive content, and skill-building programs designed to help students excel academically and develop critical soft skills. 98thPercentile focuses on preparing students for competitive academic placements and college scholarships while building confidence in communication and technical skills.

## Key Topics

- 98thPercentile
- ElevatEd
- Public Speaking
- Communication Skills

## Core Programs & Academic Placement

- [Transform Your Child into a Future Leader | 98thPercentile](https://www.98thpercentile.com/building_future_leaders): Ivy League prep program for grades 1-12 leadership development
- [The Second Window](https://www.98thpercentile.com/the-second-window-v1): Middle school placement guide for Honors, AP, IB, and Gifted programs
- [Top Scholarship Opportunities in 2024](https://www.98thpercentile.com/blog/top-scholarship-opportunities): 2024 college scholarships: Gates, Coca-Cola, Jack Kent Cooke programs
- [Tips for STAAR test](https://www.98thpercentile.com/blog/parents-guide-to-staar-test-prep): Texas STAAR test prep guide and scholarship test info for parents

## Public Speaking & Communication Skills

- [What Should an Introvert do to become a Confident Public Speaker?](https://www.98thpercentile.com/blog/confident-public-speaker): Public speaking strategies for introverts using ElevatEd program
- [Public Speaking Tips to Engage Your Audience - 98thPercentile](https://www.98thpercentile.com/blog/nine-best-opening-lines-public-speaking): Captivating speech opening techniques with examples from Steve Jobs
- [Proven Techniques to Overcome Stage Fright](https://www.98thpercentile.com/blog/proven-techniques-to-overcome-stage-fright): Breathing, meditation, and self-affirmation techniques for stage fright

## Coding & Technology

- [How to Get Started with Python for AI?](https://www.98thpercentile.com/blog/how-to-get-started-with-python-for-ai): Python AI tutorial covering TensorFlow, PyTorch, and ML basics
- [Building Simple Web Pages](https://www.98thpercentile.com/blog/building-simple-web-pages): Beginner tutorial for building web pages with HTML and CSS
- [Balancing Innovation with Security in AI and Data Privacy](https://www.98thpercentile.com/blog/security-in-ai-and-data-privacy): AI security threats, data privacy protection, and Privacy by Design

## Mathematics Education

- [Math Puzzle For Your Child - Riddle ME THIS!](https://www.98thpercentile.com/blog/math-puzzle-for-your-child-riddle-me-this): Math puzzles and riddles to boost children's problem-solving skills
- [Transformations - Rotation, Translation, Reflection, Dilation](https://www.98thpercentile.com/blog/mathematical-transformations): Mathematical transformations in geometry with real-world applications
- [Mastering Circle Arcs: Essential Geometry Insights and Applications](https://www.98thpercentile.com/blog/arc-of-a-circle-definition-properties-and-examples): Circle arc geometry: properties, arc length, and engineering applications

## English & Grammar

- [What is a Verb?](https://www.98thpercentile.com/blog/what-is-a-verb-1): English grammar guide explaining verb types and usage with examples
- [Introduction to Conjunctive Adverbs](https://www.98thpercentile.com/blog/introduction-to-conjunctive-adverbs): Grammar guide for conjunctive adverbs, usage, and punctuation rules
- [Mastering Apostrophe: A Guide to Understanding and Using this Figure of Speech](https://www.98thpercentile.com/blog/importance-of-apostrophe): Guide to apostrophe figure of speech for emotional writing impact
